questions.stem_text:
If a random variable X is normally distributed with a mean of 118 and a standard deviation
of 11, what Z-scores correspond to raw scores of 115, 134, and 99?
This biome contains plants whose roots cannot go deep due to the presence of a permafrost.
What are the major forces of evolution?

options.B: mutation, genetic drift, migration, genetic hitchhiking
options.C: mutation, genetic drift, migration, random mating
options.D: mutation, gene flow, migration, natural selection
options.E: adaptation, genetic drift, migration, natural selection

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - reproduction, migration, mutation, natural selection

questions.stem_text:
Which group is composed entirely of individuals who maintained that species are fixed
(i.e., unchanging)?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Aristotle, Linnaeus, and Cuvier

questions.stem_text: Fungi participate in each of the following EXCEPT

options.C: association with humans to produce ringworm
options.D: association with the roots of plants to form mycorrhizae

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - photosynthesis to produce glucose

questions.stem_text: Gene flow between populations increases the likelihood of speciation by enhancing genetic divergence.

differ in terms of the interactions between alleles and genes.
